Card Q&A.a: Yes. Even if you can't trash any of your opponent’s digivolution cards, you still get to give -3000 DP to 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent doesn't have any Digimon with digivolution cards in play, meaning this card's [When Digivolving] effect can't trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of my opponent's Digimon. Do I still activate the "1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards gets -3000 DP for the turn" part of the effect?

Effect: ＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards gets -3000 DP for the turn.
